## Source: amazon-inspector (c588ca6b9a165d16dfd359719e48c63cbcddf5c6e141076cc9a42165a0ae689b)
The package ferretqueue 0.1.0 contains no observed install-time network activity, no lifecycle code that fetches or executes remote content, no reads of installer credential paths, and no outbound data flows to third-party destinations. No credential-distribution, silent-relay, backdoor, or self-propagation mechanisms were identified in the shipped files.
